notes:
- Satin, Raised Satin, and Blocks tools now start with aligned needle pairs. New columns use width-based Auto Spacing, with an adjustable percentage and an editable spacing curve. Existing designs keep their saved spacing and alignment choices.
- Closest Join keeps more same-color Satin columns connected when pull compensation brings their covers together. Connected chains preserve the established entry and route transfers where the receiving column can cover them, reducing unnecessary jumps and trims.
